summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of EduOS 2026 CourseViewPage and CoursesPage features. All requested features are working correctly: student enrollment tracking, learning mode selector (Text, Video, Audio, Slides), language selector with 10 languages, teacher course creation, and teacher content upload functionality.
passed_tests: Student login (demo.student@eduos.edu / demo123)
Student can access courses page
Student sees 'View Course' button for enrolled courses
Student does NOT see 'Create Course' button (correctly hidden)
Student does NOT see 'Add Content' button in course view (correctly hidden)
CourseViewPage displays correctly with course title, description, credits
Learning mode selector shows all 4 modes (Text, Video, Audio, Slides)
Student can switch between learning modes
Text mode displays lesson content with markdown formatting
Video mode shows video placeholder with 'Play Video' button
Audio mode shows 'Generate Audio Version' button with text transcript
Slides mode shows visual slide presentation
Language selector shows all 10 languages (English, Swahili, Shona, Ndebele, Zulu, Xhosa, French, Portuguese, Arabic, Spanish)
Language selector dropdown opens and allows selection
Lesson navigation works (can switch between lessons)
Back to Courses button works
Teacher login (demo.teacher@eduos.edu / demo123)
Teacher can access courses page
Teacher sees 'Create Course' button
Teacher sees 'Manage Course' buttons for their courses
Create Course dialog opens with all form fields (Code, Name, Description, Grade Level, Credits, Max Students)
Teacher can access course view page via 'Manage Course'
Teacher sees 'Add Content' button in course view
Upload Content dialog opens with content type selector
Content type selector shows all 4 types (Text Content, Video, Audio, Image/Slides)
Upload Content dialog shows Title, Description, and Content Text/URL fields
critical_code_review_comments: CourseViewPage correctly implements role-based UI (Add Content button only for teachers)
CoursesPage correctly tracks enrolled courses and shows appropriate buttons
Learning modes are well-implemented with distinct UI for each mode
Language selector properly integrated with 10 African and international languages
Content upload dialog correctly switches between text input and URL input based on content type
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing demo accounts. Demo student is enrolled in all 4 courses (Physics, Math, Chemistry, Biology)

mocked_apis.note: No APIs are mocked - all backend APIs are functional

context_for_next_testing_agent: All CourseViewPage and CoursesPage features verified working. Student enrollment tracking works correctly - demo student is enrolled in all 4 courses so 'View Course' buttons are shown. Teachers can create courses and upload content. Learning modes (Text, Video, Audio, Slides) all work. Language selector with 10 languages works. The Upload Content dialog correctly switches between text input and URL input based on content type selection.
